newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal, deposit rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal, deposit rates unchanged.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar and riyal interbank deposit rates were unchanged in very quiet trade this week, dealers in the kingdom said on Thursday.
"The market was very quiet. Trading focused on short dates," one dealer said.
Spot-next and one-week funds were unchanged at 5-7/16, 5/16 percent.
One-month rates were quoted at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, three months at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and one-year were at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent.
Spot Saudi riyal was quoted at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.
